stem: A study of office workers in a city used a random sample to estimate the mean amount a worker spends on lunch on a workday. Based on the sample, the plausible values for the mean amount spent by all office workers in the city are from \$7.40 to \$9.20. What is the sample mean amount, in dollars?
solution: The plausible values are the sample mean minus and plus the margin of error, so the sample mean is the midpoint.
verify:
mid = (Rational('7.40') + Rational('9.20')) / 2
assert mid == Rational('8.3')
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == [mid]
